form.label: Admin: Relationships
form.description: Define who can view whom + how they are related — writes the wearable_relationships KV Store (viewer_splunk_user → person_id, relationship). Enrichment for the Family Graph + a source for generating caregiver RBAC roles; NOT the access gate (that is authorize.conf srchFilter). Admin-only via the outputlookup approve dialog.

input.label: Viewer (who can see — a Splunk login holder)

search.query: | inputlookup wearable_person_profile | where splunk_user!="" | eval label=coalesce(person_name, person_id)." (".splunk_user.")" | sort label | table splunk_user label
| inputlookup wearable_person_profile | eval label=person_id." — ".coalesce(person_name, person_id) | sort person_id | table person_id label

input.label: Relationship (viewer is the … of the related person)

search.query: | inputlookup wearable_relationships | lookup wearable_person_profile splunk_user AS viewer_splunk_user OUTPUT person_name AS vn | lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name AS rn | eval label=coalesce(vn, viewer_splunk_user)." → ".coalesce(rn, person_id)." (".relationship.")" | sort label | table _key label

div.style: border:2px solid #F4A422; background:rgba(244,164,34,0.12); border-radius:6px; padding:12px 14px; margin-bottom:14px; color:#F4A422; font-weight:600

div.div: ⚠ After you click Submit, Splunk shows a small "potential security risk" dialog (it approves the outputlookup command). On the dark theme it is easy to miss — look near the center of the screen and click "Run Query Anyway". Nothing is written until you finish the fields (including Confirm), click Submit, and approve.
div.p: This page maintains the wearable_relationships registry (KV Store) — the caregiver→dependent edges that power the Family Graph and are the source for generating each viewer's per-person RBAC roles. Writes are locked to admin/sc_admin.

ul.li: Viewer is the person who can see — chosen from people who have a Splunk login mapped (set that on Admin → People & Defaults). People with no login cannot be a viewer.
Related person is who is being viewed (any person). Relationship is how the viewer relates to them (a self edge marks the viewer's own person).
One edge per viewer → related person: re-writing the same pair updates it (relationship / can-view), it does not duplicate.
Access is still enforced by RBAC (srchFilter on person_id), not this table — see RBAC.md. This registry is enrichment + the source for role generation.

panel.title: Current relationships — click a row to load it into the Add / Edit form above

search.query: | inputlookup wearable_relationships ```refresh:$rel_refresh$``` | lookup wearable_person_profile splunk_user AS viewer_splunk_user OUTPUT person_name AS viewer_name | lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name AS related_name | fillnull value="" relationship can_view | eval Viewer=coalesce(viewer_name, viewer_splunk_user), Related=coalesce(related_name, person_id) | sort Viewer Related | table Viewer Related relationship can_view viewer_splunk_user person_id

| inputlookup wearable_relationships | eval _match=if(viewer_splunk_user=="$r_viewer$" AND person_id=="$r_person$", 1, 0) | where _match=1 | appendpipe [| stats count | where count==0 | eval viewer_splunk_user="$r_viewer$", person_id="$r_person$"] | eval viewer_splunk_user="$r_viewer$", person_id="$r_person$" | eval _rel=if("$r_rel$"=="null", "", "$r_rel$") | eval relationship=if(_rel=="", coalesce(relationship, "viewer"), _rel) | eval _cn=if("$r_can$"=="null", "", "$r_can$") | eval can_view=if(_cn=="", coalesce(can_view, "true"), _cn) | where "$r_viewer$"!="" AND "$r_person$"!="" | appendpipe [| table _key viewer_splunk_user person_id relationship can_view | outputlookup append=t wearable_relationships | where 1=2] | eval outcome="written" | lookup wearable_person_profile splunk_user AS viewer_splunk_user OUTPUT person_name AS Viewer | lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name AS Related | eval Viewer=coalesce(Viewer, viewer_splunk_user), Related=coalesce(Related, person_id) | table outcome Viewer Related relationship can_view
| inputlookup wearable_relationships | where _key!="$rr_key$" | outputlookup wearable_relationships | stats count as relationships_remaining
